explanation: I found no single Mathlib declaration that states this directly. Mathlib has the instance `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity (ZMod p) (p - 1)` in `Mathlib/RingTheory/ZMod/Torsion.lean`. It also has `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.of_dvd` and `HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.exists_isPrimitiveRoot`. Getting from these to the theorem takes several steps: build `Fact p.Prime` and `NeZero (p - 1)`, apply `of_dvd`, then apply `exists_isPrimitiveRoot`. That is more than one or two short lines, so it is not a special case. I also searched `Mathlib/FieldTheory/Finite`, which has no `IsPrimitiveRoot` statements. A grep for `∃ ζ, IsPrimitiveRoot` and for `∣ p - 1` turned up no ready-made lemma for `ZMod p` or finite fields.
